description:
MRI with contrast shows:

infratentorial dural-based well-defined space occupying lesion in the right cerebellar hemisphere, it is heterogeneous on all sequences (it has solid and cystic components)

The solid component is hypointense on T1, and slightly hyperintense on T2 and FLAIR , and avidly enhancing on T1C+

the cystic components are of intensity similar to CSF on all sequences

the lesion is surrounded by vasogenic edema and exerts mass effects on the posterior fossa structures, it is compressing the right cerebellar hemisphere and the 4th ventricle and slightly pushing the right cerebellar tonsil downward , and displacing the cerebral peduncles and the cerebral aqueduct to the left

multifocal areas of hyperintensity are noted on T2 and FLAIR in the subcortical white matter, mainly represent age related changes

minimal periventricular transependymal edema was noted, no hydrocephalus
